questions.stem: Which starting-zone quest item teaches Skinning?
questions.explanation: Pelt Collecting for Beginners teaches Skinning and gives +2 skill. Wild Harvest teaches Herbalism, and Mining for Dummies teaches Mining.

questions.stem: Which of these is a new scarce Skinning material?
questions.explanation: Skinning can yield Pristine Leather, Pristine Hide and Pristine Scale. Pitchblende is a scarce ore and Rosecap a scarce herb.

questions.stem: Which Skinning camp object unlocks at skill 300?
questions.explanation: The Camp Chair comes at skill 20, the Field Guide at 140 and the Trapper's Workbench at 300.

questions.stem: The Field Guide is also the name of a Legacy perk. What does the perk do?
questions.explanation: The Field Guide perk shortens the camp-feature cooldown. Gourmand makes food buffs last longer and Master Chef gives extra cooking results. The Field Guide camp object is a separate thing, unlocked at Skinning 140.

questions.stem: Which Legacy perk improves your skill-up chance?
questions.explanation: Working Overtime improves your skill-up chance. Bountiful Harvest gives extra Scarce resources, and Master Chef gives extra cooking results.

questions.stem: What does the Camp Chair give?
questions.explanation: The Camp Chair gives 2% crit. Grilled Squid and Hot Smoked Bass give +1% crit, and Mightfish Steak +40 attack power.

questions.stem: Which class buff does the Camp Chair match, so that the two do not stack?
questions.explanation: The Camp Chair matches Moonkin Aura. The Mining Lodestone is the one that matches Blessing of Might.

questions.stem: Which Pristine material is the Bottomless Reagent Bag made from?
questions.explanation: The Bottomless Reagent Bag is made from Pristine Hide, so that is the Pristine material to hold back.
